GSP is short for an existing item in Magicka named the Greater Shield of Protection. A "heater" shield isn't about heat. It just means the typical pointy-end-at-the-bottom medieval shield: http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Heater_shield

A crafty heater shield, not meant for spellcasting, but more efficiant than the standard issue GSP. Indeed, this shield actually is considered to be holy, as indicated by the cross emblazoned on its face. #PA;Decreased spell efficiency #AA;Shieldbash
